topics.purpose: Define topics as machine-readable semantic grouping/navigation projections over exact contracts/members without becoming duplicate semantic owners.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant Topic has an explicit identity.
semantics.member_rule: Topic membership uses exact member refs.
semantics.composition_rule: Topic grouping does not create semantic containment/ownership unless separately declared.
semantics.authority_rule: Topic membership grants no operation/data authority.
semantics.closure_rule: Topic hierarchy can be enumerated deterministically.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
